title: YouTube AdFree
appDescription: GTV development build of YouTube AdFree, built from webosbrew upstream 0.5.3. It keeps the release ad-blocking, Shorts-removal, sponsored-overlay, and playback-hook hardening, profiles recent and large structured responses without depending on the legacy Home response path, and presents the frozen diagnostics snapshot as real photograph-sized pages. Blue opens the report and advances one page per press; Back is the only way to close it, avoiding unreliable D-pad scrolling entirely. The report captures top-level response shapes, renderer/view-model paths, ad/masthead/promo signal keys, notable arrays, response-shape counts, and a small allowlist of safe scalar schema hints while excluding tracking/auth/token/URL payload data.
